integrity: Analytical proof with independent numerical integration and direct tangent-vector simulation. No independent audit or publication-priority certification; full texts of relevant cap-shape literature were not accessible.
limitations: Uniform arclength points on one fixed spherical small circle only; intrinsic geodesic angles rather than Euclidean chord angles. Exact law is a one-dimensional definite integral. The forbidden belt is not identifiable from the zero probability; endpoints of colatitude excluded.
title: A sharp latitude threshold and exact acute-triangle law on spherical small circles
